_meta.purpose: Figma-ready annotation package. Priority screenshots + design annotations for presentation.

priority_screenshots.label: TripGenie — AI Q&A Travel Assistant
priority_screenshots.annotation: Trip.com's AI sidekick model. Tagline: 'Beyond conversations: AI weaves your dream trips.' Covers Inspiration, Flights, Attractions, Practical tips. Q&A format, not planning conversation. 1M+ attractions. This is the FAQ-AI pattern that every OTA will adopt by 2027.
priority_screenshots.saudia_relevance: High — Saudia should build this first, scoped to Saudia-exclusive knowledge (Hajj, Alfursan, Saudi visa, Islamic services)

priority_screenshots.label: Trip.Planner — Structured AI Planning Form
priority_screenshots.annotation: A third AI planning model (Mindtrip=chat, Trip.com=form+map). UI: Starting from Any → Heading to → Date/Duration → Preferences → Create. Map-integrated output. Lower cognitive load than freeform chat. Labeled 'New' in navigation — brand-new product.
priority_screenshots.saudia_relevance: High — Saudia version would pre-fill 'Starting From' with Saudia flight origin, reducing form to Destination + Duration + Preferences

priority_screenshots.label: Arabic Auto-Localization — Full RTL Interface
priority_screenshots.annotation: When accessed from Arabic locale (ar-SA), Trip.com presents full Arabic UI: RTL layout, Arabic placeholders ('إلى أين؟' = 'Where to?'), Arabic navigation. Deeper than Mindtrip's Arabic content in discovery feed — this is a full product switch. Now seen in 2 benchmarks: pattern is Gaining Traction.
priority_screenshots.saudia_relevance: Critical — Saudia has Arabic UI but no Arabic AI. The next frontier is Arabic-language AI, not just Arabic UI.

priority_screenshots.label: Native Booking — Full Multi-Modal Coverage
priority_screenshots.annotation: Trip.com offers native booking across: Flights + Hotels + Trains + Car services + Attractions. The 'Trains' product is unique in this benchmark cycle. Full booking without leaving platform — this solves Mindtrip's biggest gap. Saudia has this advantage too. Never create a referral break.
priority_screenshots.saudia_relevance: Validate — Saudia's native booking is its core advantage. Protect it. Long-term: explore Haramain HSR + Saudia air integration.

priority_screenshots.label: Trip.com Loyalty — Trip Coins + Tiered Membership
priority_screenshots.annotation: Trip Coins earned on all bookings, redeemable across all products. Tiered membership with incremental benefits. Loyalty integrated into booking flow. However: Trip Coins are generic spend-to-earn. Saudia's Alfursan has richer data (route patterns, seat preferences, travel companions) — a deeper personalization engine if AI-activated.
priority_screenshots.saudia_relevance: High — Saudia should AI-activate Alfursan data rather than building a more complex loyalty structure

innovation_callouts.title: The Two AI Philosophies
innovation_callouts.body: After 2 benchmarks: Mindtrip = AI is the product (no booking). Trip.com = AI is a sidekick (full OTA + AI layer). Saudia belongs in the Trip.com camp — it has inventory, loyalty, and direct booking. The AI layer is what it needs to add.
innovation_callouts.implication_for_saudia: Build AI-as-Sidekick on existing Saudia platform. Do not try to become Mindtrip.

innovation_callouts.title: TripGenie vs. Mindtrip AI: Two Different Use Cases
innovation_callouts.body: Mindtrip AI: 'Plan me 7 days in Japan.' → Full itinerary generated. TripGenie: 'What do I do if my flight is cancelled?' → Practical answer. These are not competing — they are different phases of the travel journey. Saudia needs both: a planning AI AND a travel-support AI.
innovation_callouts.implication_for_saudia: Build travel-support Q&A first (faster, lower risk). Add planning AI second.

innovation_callouts.title: Arabic AI is the Gap Nobody Has Filled
innovation_callouts.body: Trip.com has Arabic UI. Mindtrip has Arabic content. Neither has Arabic-language AI. An AI assistant that responds in Gulf Arabic, understands Hajj context, and knows Saudi geography is unclaimed territory.
innovation_callouts.implication_for_saudia: Saudia should own Arabic AI. It is Saudia's most defensible AI territory.
